corrections.reason: Kept the first-person finite form and the figurative faire figure context.
Retained the idiomatic abandonment of the comparison rather than teaching a place adverb.
Moved the middle and upper questions to the short-life metaphor in the source.

note: The source meaning and each authored 1–3, 4–5 and 6–8 question were inspected individually for meaning, grammatical choices and a distinct intended answer. The item notes record the source basis and concrete corrections. This is offline review, not learner import or an endorsement of unexamined published reuse questions.

items.reviewNote: Je n’en ai vu aucuns is a historical plural pronoun with negative force; it means none of those beings. The later aucuns projets is a determiner in the same historical orthography. The three question bands distinguish none; not any of them from the stated alternatives.
N’ose faire aucuns projets uses the historical plural determiner before projets; a separate pronoun use occurs earlier. The three question bands distinguish no; not any from the stated alternatives.

Qui n’aient plus de désirs uses subjunctive avoir after a negative antecedent; the verb indicates possession of desires. The three question bands distinguish have; possess from the stated alternatives.

La matière est partout étendue uses the feminine adjective to say matter has spatial extension; the later l’étendue and d’étendue are nouns. The three question bands distinguish extended; occupying space from the stated alternatives.

The noun l’étendue is listed as a property of matter, and d’étendue is what thinking beings allegedly lack. Both concern occupying space, unlike the adjective at 50:23. The three question bands distinguish extension; spatial extent from the stated alternatives.

The secretary begins to compare the blondes’ and brunettes’ attire or ornaments; the published set-of-jewelry gloss is too narrow for this unspecified, interrupted image. The three question bands distinguish adornments; finery from the stated alternatives.

The many passions result from many senses and feed the feeling of unmet desire, distinct from published sustained commitment to a pursuit. The three question bands distinguish passions; strong emotions or desires from the stated alternatives.

Près de mille sens estimates a count close to a thousand; the published spatial-near identity and questions do not teach this quantity use. The three question bands distinguish nearly; approximately from the stated alternatives.

À peine a-t-on commencé à s’instruire concerns the process of learning before death; the published legal investigation questions are a different sense. The three question bands distinguish learn; educate oneself from the stated alternatives.

Le don de la pensée is the ability to think shared by thinking beings, not one particular thought in the published question set. The three question bands distinguish thought; faculty of thinking from the stated alternatives.

items.meaning: aside; leave it there and abandon it
items.reviewNote: Laissez là votre parterre dismisses the garden comparison. The published location-there quiz does not teach this idiomatic abandonment. The three question bands distinguish aside; leave it there and abandon it from the stated alternatives. Retained the idiomatic abandonment of the comparison rather than teaching a place adverb.

items.meaning: as for; from the standpoint of
items.reviewNote: Pour moi introduces the speaker’s personal perspective; the other pour vous plaire remains the published purpose sense. The three question bands distinguish as for; from the standpoint of from the stated alternatives.

items.meaning: among; in the world or community of
items.reviewNote: Chez nous, chez vous and chez moi refer to planets or their inhabitants in this interplanetary dialogue, beyond the apartment/home premises taught by the published quiz. The three question bands distinguish among; in the world or community of from the stated alternatives.

La figure ridicule que je fais means the ridiculous appearance or impression I present; published material fabrication and causative action questions are different. The three question bands distinguish make; present an appearance from the stated alternatives. Kept the first-person finite form and the figurative faire figure context.

Par exemple introduces an illustration of differences and commonalities; published precedent and exemplary model questions teach other senses. The three question bands distinguish example; illustrative case from the stated alternatives.

The travelers count seventy-two or nearly a thousand sensory faculties, distinct from published direction/sound-judgment questions. Bon sens at 47:36 remains judgment. The three question bands distinguish senses; faculties of perception from the stated alternatives.

Notre existence est un point compares life to a dimensionless speck; published not-at-all and à point questions do not cover this nominal metaphor. The three question bands distinguish point; tiny extent of time from the stated alternatives. Moved the middle and upper questions to the short-life metaphor in the source.

Faire une figure ridicule means to cut a ridiculous figure before the traveler. Published anatomical face and rank/status quizzes do not match this social appearance. The three question bands distinguish figure; impression one cuts from the stated alternatives.

items.meaning: goes beyond; extends past a limit
items.reviewNote: Notre imagination va au delà de nos besoins means it exceeds them metaphorically, unlike a physical journey or progressive auxiliary in published quizzes. The three question bands distinguish goes beyond; extends past a limit from the stated alternatives.

Tire sur le rouge describes a hue approaching red. Published on and about do not teach color tendency, so this use is separated. The three question bands distinguish toward; tending to a color from the stated alternatives.

items.meaning: been; stayed or visited a place
items.reviewNote: J’ai été dans les pays means the traveler has been in those places. The published été question set tests being happy or being a guide; this spatial-presence use needs its own contextual identity and three bands. The three question bands distinguish been; stayed or visited a place from the stated alternatives.
